🏨 Front-desk morning board

Runs daily at 07:00. Pulls live occupancy from LSH (/api/hotel/rooms) and builds {{ $json.summary }}.

SETUP (one step): open the "LSH occupancy" node → Credential for Header Auth → create one named Authorization with value:  Bearer <your LSH API token>  (Settings → n8n API is NOT this; use an LSH API token). Then ACTIVATE this workflow.

Tip: don't click Execute until the credential is set, or n8n errors on the empty auth slot.
